cohort: 7398 deliveries under the direct care of the author over 25 years.
finding: The rate of cesarean section was maintained at 19% over the last 10 years of the study, likely due to a high rate of vaginal births after cesarean (VBACs) and rotational Kiwi deliveries.
mod_finding: The relatively low rate of cesarean section was attributed to high rates of VBAC and rotational Kiwi deliveries.
